Twitch._comment: Prefer `dotnet user-secrets` or environment variables (TwitchBridge__Twitch__OAuthToken, etc.) over committing real credentials here. ModeratorAccessToken/ModeratorRefreshToken are a *separate* user token pair (broadcaster or a mod, not the bot) carrying moderator:read:followers -- required only for the follow-bonus feature, leave both blank to disable it. Only read once as a seed; ModeratorTokenStore auto-refreshes and persists the rotated pair to data/moderator-token.json after that, so these never need updating by hand again.

Overlay._comment: 127.0.0.1-only by default so the overlay isn't reachable off the streamer's own machine.
